name: Deep Pockets
description: This Pokemon can hold and use two different items at once.

mechanic.berries_and_consumables: Each slot is independent; consuming one does not consume the other.
mechanic.knock_off: Removes one held item per successful item-removal event; slot resolution must be deterministic.
mechanic.trick_switcheroo: Transfers or swaps one item slot per move execution; never duplicates or destroys the untouched slot.
mechanic.choice_items: All applicable bonuses stack. Any active Choice item applies the normal move lock; multiple Choice items do not create multiple locks.
mechanic.unburden: Triggers only when the Pokemon has no remaining held item in either slot.
mechanic.poltergeist_and_item_checks: Pokemon counts as holding an item if either slot is occupied.
mechanic.faint_switch_battle_end: Second slot persists exactly like the primary held item.
